title: Work of the Fourier estimator
statement: For a small-bias Fourier estimation input with $n>0$, positive accuracy numerator, twice the numerator at most the denominator, and Fourier bound at least $1$, and for any finite coordinate set $U$ in the input dimension, the estimator's work is the sum of the deterministic small-bias construction work, the sample count, and the Fourier estimator work at that sample count and set $U$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
$U$ is a finite set of coordinates in the input dimension
